facts.text: The Heart of Detroit Tuition Pledge covers tuition and standard mandatory fees for Detroit high school graduates and Detroit residents for up to four years of full-time study.

sources.title: Tuition pledge programs - Financial Aid - Wayne State University
sources.quote: The Heart of Detroit Tuition Pledge offers free tuition for students of Detroit high schools or Detroit residents earning a high school diploma.

facts.text: The Wayne State Guarantee covers 100% of tuition and standard fees through federal, state, and university scholarships and grants for eligible undergraduates with household income of $80,000 or less.

sources.title: Wayne State Guarantee - Admissions - Wayne State University
sources.quote: The Wayne State Guarantee, one of many scholarship opportunities at WSU, covers 100% of tuition and standard fees through a combination of federal, state and Wayne State scholarships and grants.
